# Majorsilence Reporting

> Open-source RDL (Report Definition Language) engine for .NET 8 & 10. Renders PDF, Excel (XLSX), HTML, CSV, RTF, XML, TIFF, and MHT from SQL, JSON, or plain C# objects. Apache 2.0 licensed, cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows), distributed as NuGet packages. An open alternative to Crystal Reports and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).

Majorsilence Reporting parses standard RDL XML report definitions and renders them server-side without requiring .NET Framework, a Windows server, or a commercial license. Reports can pull data from SQLite, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebird, JSON, XML, or data injected directly from C# objects via `SetData()`.

## Core packages

- [Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlEngine.SkiaSharp](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlEngine.SkiaSharp): core parsing and rendering engine (required)
- [Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlCri.SkiaSharp](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlCri.SkiaSharp): barcode/QR code custom report items (ZXing.Net)
- [Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlCreator.SkiaSharp](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlCreator.SkiaSharp): programmatic report/document creation

- [Quick Start Guide](https://reporting.majorsilence.com/posts/2025/12/28/quick-start.html): installation, key concepts (RdlEngineConfigInit, RunGetData/RunRender), first PDF render
- [Replacing Crystal Reports and SSRS](https://reporting.majorsilence.com/posts/2026/06/20/replacing-crystal-reports-ssrs.html): migration guide from legacy reporting tools
- [Adding Charts to Your Reports](https://reporting.majorsilence.com/posts/2026/06/13/charts.html)
- [Reporting Examples Cookbook](https://reporting.majorsilence.com/posts/2026/06/20/example-cookbook.html): eight real-world report patterns
- [Native AOT and Trimming Support](https://reporting.majorsilence.com/posts/2026/06/21/aot-compatibility.html)
- [SDKs](https://reporting.majorsilence.com/sdks/): Python, PHP, Ruby, and Rust clients
- [GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/majorsilence/Reporting/wiki): full documentation, migration guides, data provider configuration
